# Retain error details in the fallible Exchange URI parser

D228378 proposes returning a message-key sentinel from the channel URI parser. The author keeps nsresult because discarding the original failure makes diagnosis harder. The actual landing and fixed accepted successor preserve nsresult with separate key/folder-path outputs. This is a scoped accepted alternative for this fallible parser, not a requirement that all helpers return nsresult or a claim that callers recover from every status. No parser failure or navigation was executed.

Scope: Exchange URI parser error contract.
